description: End-to-end moderation and review workflow for telco network change calendar, from proposal submission through risk evaluation, approvals, scheduling, execution monitoring, and rollback/cancellation.

change_id.description: Unique identifier for a specific change request in the telco change calendar.

change_window_id.description: Identifier for a proposed or approved change window/time slot.

task_id.description: Identifier for an individual implementation or validation task within a change.

approval_id.description: Identifier for a specific approval decision or approval workflow instance.

user_ref.description: Reference to a user or automation actor.

role.description: Primary role or function of the user in NetOps.

network_scope.description: Scope of network elements and services impacted by the change.

risk_assessment.description: Structured risk assessment for a change.

dependencies.description: Other changes or systems this change depends on.

approval_decision.description: Approval decision, used in multiple approval-related functions.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to conditional approval, if any.

effective_until.description: If set, approval expires after this time.

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: submit_change_proposal
functions.description: Submit a new change proposal to the telco change calendar for moderation and review.

description.description: Detailed description including business justification and technical context.

flexibility.description: How flexible the requested timing is.

attachments.description: Optional design documents or diagrams linked by URL.

functions.returns: Newly created change proposal including generated change_id and initial moderation status.

functions.name: auto_moderate_change
functions.description: Run automated moderation and policy checks on a submitted change proposal.

run_static_analysis.description: If true, analyze implementation commands for known risks.

run_historical_analysis.description: If true, correlate with historical incident/change data.

functions.returns: Automated moderation result including policy violations, risk flags, and recommended next actions.

functions.name: evaluate_change_risk
functions.description: Compute detailed risk assessment for a change proposal, combining automated signals and optional human input.

business_impact_input.description: Optional business impact notes from requestor or product owner.

critical_services.description: Names or IDs of critical services impacted.

risk_model.description: Which risk model configuration to use.

functions.returns: Computed risk_assessment object, including overall_risk_level, scores, constraints, dependencies, and mitigation recommendations.

functions.name: suggest_change_window
functions.description: Suggest one or more feasible change windows based on blackout periods, risk level, and existing calendar load.

time_preferences.description: Preferences for timing of the change.

lookahead_days.description: How far into the future to search for windows.

functions.returns: List of suggested change windows with change_window_id, start/end, conflict score, and justification.

functions.name: create_change_approval_request
functions.description: Create a structured approval workflow for a change, targeting the right approvers based on risk and scope.

approver_groups.description: Explicit list of approver groups or roles to involve.

functions.returns: Created approval workflow including approval_id, required approvers, and current approval status.

functions.name: record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approval decision (human or automated) for a change approval workflow.

decision_scope.description: Scope of what this decision applies to.

evidence_links.description: Optional links to evidence (test results, simulations).

functions.returns: Updated approval workflow status, including aggregated approval outcome and any newly applied conditions.

functions.name: get_change_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details and current status for a change, including moderation, risk, approvals, and schedule.

redact_sensitive.description: If true, hide sensitive command or credential details.

functions.returns: Comprehensive change object including metadata, scope, risk, approvals, schedule, and execution state.

functions.name: list_calendar_changes
functions.description: List and filter changes in the calendar for a given time range, with moderation and status filters.
functions.returns: Paginated list of calendar changes with summary fields and basic status/moderation info.

functions.name: check_execution_readiness
functions.description: Pre-execution readiness check to ensure all preconditions (approvals, dependencies, monitoring, backups) are satisfied.

override_execution_time.description: If provided, check readiness as of this time instead of current time.

functions.returns: Readiness report with pass/fail per check, blocking issues, and recommended mitigations or rescheduling advice.

functions.name: update_change_tasks
functions.description: Create or update detailed implementation and validation tasks for a change, used for execution tracking.

tasks.description: Full task definitions to upsert for this change.

sequence.description: Execution sequence number; lower executes earlier.

automation.description: Automation job or playbook details, if task is automated.

reference_id.description: Reference to automation artifact (e.g., playbook name, workflow ID).

mode.description: Replace existing tasks or merge with them.

functions.returns: Updated list of tasks for the change including assigned task_ids and any validation warnings.

functions.name: update_execution_status
functions.description: Update execution status of a change and its tasks during or after implementation, including incident linkage.

status_reason.description: Free-text reason or summary for the new status.

linked_incidents.description: List of incident IDs in external systems associated with this change status update.

functions.returns: Updated execution state of the change including current status, timeline, and task states.

functions.name: request_change_rollback
functions.description: Request a rollback for an in-progress or recently completed change, with automated and manual moderation.

auto_execute.description: If true and allowed by policy, automatically trigger rollback implementation tasks.

functions.returns: Rollback request record including moderation outcome, whether rollback is approved, and any triggered rollback tasks.

functions.name: cancel_or_reschedule_change
functions.description: Cancel a pending change or reschedule it to a new window, enforcing policy and moderation rules.

from_suggestion_id.description: Optional reference to a previously suggested window.

notify_parties.description: List of stakeholders to notify about cancellation/reschedule.

force.description: If true, override some non-critical policy checks (e.g., last-minute reschedules) if caller has privilege.

functions.returns: Updated change schedule or cancellation confirmation, including new change_window_id if rescheduled and notification summary.

functions.name: search_change_review_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across change_review entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching change_review entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_change_review_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N change_review records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_change_review_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many change_review records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_change_review_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many change_review records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_change_review_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of change_review data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_change_review_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a change_review dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_change_review_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more change_review entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_change_review_snapshot
functions.description: Restore change_review state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_change_review_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the change_review workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_change_review_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across change_review metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_change_review_audit_events
functions.description: Search the change_review audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_change_review_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers change_review workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_change_review_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for change_review events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_change_review_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for change_review events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_change_review_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off change_review job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_change_review_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled change_review jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_change_review_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled change_review job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_change_review_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a change_review operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_change_review_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a change_review action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_change_review_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a change_review approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_change_review_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any change_review entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_change_review_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a change_review entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_change_review_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling change_review behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_change_review_policies
functions.description: List change_review policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_change_review_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two change_review-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_change_review_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a change_review entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_change_review_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many change_review entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
